nodes.name: Every Monday 9:00 IST
nodes.notes: Starts the digest every Monday at 09:00 Asia/Kolkata.

nodes.name: Run now (test)
nodes.notes: Starts the same digest on demand, for testing.

parameters.query:
WITH w AS (SELECT now() - interval '7 days' AS since)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM failure_ledger, w WHERE first_seen_at >= since)::int AS new_signatures,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM failure_ledger, w WHERE last_seen_at  >= since)::int AS active_signatures,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM failure_ledger WHERE status = 'open')::int  AS open_count,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM failure_ledger WHERE status = 'fixed')::int AS fixed_count,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT id, workflow_name, failed_node, left(error_message, 120) AS error_message, recurrence_count
     FROM failure_ledger, w WHERE first_seen_at >= since
     ORDER BY first_seen_at DESC LIMIT 5) t) AS new_list,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT id, workflow_name, failed_node, left(error_message, 120) AS error_message, recurrence_count, status
     FROM failure_ledger, w WHERE last_seen_at >= since
     ORDER BY recurrence_count DESC LIMIT 5) t) AS top_recurring;

nodes.name: Query ledger
nodes.notes: Counts new and active signatures and open vs fixed, and lists the top recurring and new failures from the last 7 days.

nodes.name: Sheets enabled?
nodes.notes: Continues to Google Sheets only when DIGEST_SHEETS_ENABLED is "true".

nodes.name: Append row to Sheet
nodes.notes: Appends one row per week to the Digest tab of the sheet in DIGEST_SHEET_ID.

parameters.content:
## Weekly digest
Monday 09:00 **Asia/Kolkata** (set in workflow settings, so it does not depend on the server timezone).

Google Sheets is optional: set `DIGEST_SHEETS_ENABLED=true` and `DIGEST_SHEET_ID`, add a Google Sheets credential to **Append row to Sheet**, and give the sheet a tab named `Digest` with the column headers in the README.
